title: Dealer Ordering Portal for Manufacturers
seoTitle: Dealer Ordering Portal for Indian Manufacturers
seoDescription: A dealer and distributor ordering portal for manufacturers: catalogue, dealer-specific pricing, credit limits, order status, invoices and Tally sync.
summary: A dealer ordering portal lets distributors and dealers place orders, check stock, see their own prices and credit, and track dispatch without calling the sales office. For manufacturers selling through a channel, it removes order-taking by phone and WhatsApp and gives the sales team time to grow accounts instead of typing orders.

dataPoints.label: Replaces
dataPoints.value: Orders by phone, WhatsApp and email re-typed into Tally

dataPoints.label: Core features
dataPoints.value: Catalogue, dealer-specific price lists and schemes, credit check, order tracking, invoices and ledger

dataPoints.label: Integrations
dataPoints.value: Tally or ERP for stock, pricing, invoices and outstanding

dataPoints.label: Access
dataPoints.value: Web portal and mobile-friendly screens; WhatsApp notifications

body:
## Why dealers adopt it

Dealers use a portal when it saves them effort: fast reordering of usual items, clear stock and dispatch dates, and their ledger on demand. Force-fitting a complex screen fails; a simple reorder flow succeeds.

## Key design decisions

- Pricing and schemes come from one source of truth.
- Orders above the credit limit go to approval, not rejection.
- Status updates go out on WhatsApp automatically.

See the [customer portal cost guide](/cost/customer-portal) and [custom app or WhatsApp bot](/compare/custom-app-vs-whatsapp-bot).

Want to see what this would look like for your business? [Book a 30-minute scoping call](/book-consultation).

faqs.q: What if dealers still send WhatsApp orders?
faqs.a: Staff can enter them in the portal on the dealer's behalf, so all orders flow through one system.

faqs.q: Can it show dealer outstanding from Tally?
faqs.a: Yes, through a Tally integration that syncs ledger balances regularly.
